html:
Checkout across devices

The buyer pays on the web and later reads the receipt on a phone. (5 screens, 3 steps, 2 lanes)

Scroll to explore the flow; screen details follow.

  1. Cart (Web lane): 4 regions: header, lines, summary, pay button; next: Payment (Pay)
    1. pay button: Disabled while the cart is empty
    2. lines: Quantity changes save at once
  2. Payment (Web lane): 3 regions: header, card form, confirm; next: Thanks (Card accepted)
    1. card form: Card number is never stored
  3. Thanks (Web lane): 2 regions: header, confirmation; end of flow
  4. Inbox (Phone lane): 2 regions: title, messages; next: Receipt (Open)
  5. Receipt (Phone lane): 3 regions: title, receipt, share; end of flow
    1. share: Opens the share sheet
